name: M-ALPHA
summary: M-ALPHA, also known as 3,4-methylenedioxy-α-ethyl-N-methylbenzylamine or as α-ethyl-N-methylpiperonylamine, is a psychoactive drug of the substituted benzylamine group. It was reported by Alexander Shulgin in his book PIHKAL as a positional isomer of MDMA. Subsequently, the drug was encountered as a designer drug in the United Kingdom in 2010 and was reported to the EMCDDA new drug monitoring service.

uses.text: M-ALPHA was encountered as a designer drug by 2010.

summaryZh: 1-甲氨基-1-(3,4-亞甲二氧基苯基)丙烷（英語：1-Methylamino-1-propane）或M-ALPHA是一種神入感激發劑，亞歷山大·舒爾金在他的著作《PiHKAL》中描述它是MDMA的位置異構體。該藥物隨後在2010年被發現在英國作為設計師藥物出售，並向歐洲毒品和毒癮監測中心新藥監測機構報告。
